name: DWD Weather (Deutscher Wetterdienst)
description: DWD weather for Mittelfranken using DWD's public open-data services (ADR-0026). All three capabilities are LIVE: weather.warnings (E18-02, CAP 1.2 DISTRICT feed), weather.observations (E18-04, POI CSV), weather.radar (E18-03, GeoServer WMS Radar_rv_product_1x1km_ger — a GetMap frame series clipped to the target bbox, fetched by the browser directly). Places + warncells + POI stations bundled in data/mittelfranken.json (Nürnberg / Fürth / Erlangen / Schwabach / Ansbach / Neustadt a.d. Aisch). Outbound HTTPS to opendata.dwd.de / maps.dwd.de only, no credentials, no new runtime dependency (stdlib urllib/zipfile/csv/ElementTree).
